announcements.title: Notice of Special Membership Meeting - August 20, 2026
announcements.body:
Dear Owners,

Attached please find the official notice for the Special Membership Meeting to
be held on Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 10:00 AM in the Building I Recreation
Room, immediately followed by the Board of Directors' Meeting. Both meetings
will also be available via Zoom.

The sole purpose of the Special Membership Meeting is to vote on a proposed
$2,500,000 revolving line of credit to fund the accelerated balcony
waterproofing project.

The attached packet includes the full meeting notice, agenda, background
information on the proposed line of credit, a Limited Proxy with Ballot, and a
Voting Certificate (required only for units with multiple owners, to designate a
single authorized voter). If you are unable to attend in person, please complete
and return the enclosed proxy as early as possible to help us establish a quorum
and tabulate votes.

This same packet is also being sent to all owners via physical mail this week,
including a return envelope for the completed Proxy and, if applicable, the
signed Voting Certificate.

Sincerely,

Ian Wilbraham, President
By Order of the Board of
Directors

announcements.title: Notice: Bicycle Storage Requirements
announcements.body:
Dear Owners,

This is a friendly reminder that, in accordance with the L’Ambiance Rules and
Regulations, all bicycles must be stored in one of the Association’s designated
bicycle storage rooms.

Bicycles may not be stored in individual parking spaces or other garage common
areas. Parking spaces are designated for vehicle parking only, and bicycles left
in these areas may also create concerns with Fire Marshal requirements and safe
access within the garages.

We have recently noticed several bicycles being stored in the garages outside of
the designated bicycle rooms, and ask that they be relocated as soon as
possible.

If you need assistance moving your bicycle, please contact the office or
concierge team and we will be happy to assist.

As a reminder, all bicycles stored in the bicycle rooms should have a visible
identification sticker showing the owner’s unit number. Blank stickers are
available from the Management Office.

We also encourage owners who have bicycles they no longer use to consider
donating or removing them from the property. This will help free up valuable
space in the bicycle rooms for residents who regularly use them.

Thank you for your cooperation and for helping us keep the garages safe,
organized, and accessible for everyone.

If you have any questions or need assistance, please contact the Management
Office.

Sincerely,

The Management Team
